reports.title: BILL Reports First Quarter Fiscal Year 2027 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Financial Outlook
section: We are providing the following guidance for the fiscal second quarter ending December 31, 2026 and the full fiscal year ending June 30, 2027.

Q2 FY27Guidance | FY27Guidance
Total revenue (millions) | $353.0 - $363.0 | $1,433.5 - $1,463.5
Year-over-year total revenue growth | 8% - 11% | 10% - 12%
Core revenue (millions) | $315.5 - $325.5 | $1,283.5 - $1,313.5
Year-over-year core revenue growth | 10% - 13% | 11% - 14%
Non-GAAP operating income (millions) | $112.5 - $117.5 | $466.0 - $486.0
Non-GAAP net income (millions) | $98.0 - $102.0 | $409.0 - $425.0
Non-GAAP net income per diluted share | $0.97 - $1.01 | $3.99 - $4.15

The outlook for non-GAAP net income and non-GAAP net income per diluted share includes a non-GAAP provision for income taxes of 20%. The outlook for non-GAAP net income per diluted share does not take any future repurchases of BILL shares into account, as the impact of such repurchases on a per diluted share basis is not reasonably estimable.
